BiblicalUsage: Here is riphyôwn: it means slackness. It stands in Jeremiah 47:3: "…look back to children for feebleness of hands".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put riphyôwn here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
